definition: a sweet smell; pleasant odour; fragrance.
example_en: A sweet fragrance wafted out of the kitchen.

definition: any climbing plant; a climber; a creeper.

definition: to season food with oil, spices, asafoetida, etc.
example_en: Grandmother was smiling as she seasoned the stir-fry.

definition: to have purple-twilight, as during the sunset.

definition: that much quantity which is more than required.

example_en: Grain in excess of the requirement was stored in the granary.

definition: brilliance; lustre.

definition: a carrying out a work, assignment etc. according to the rules governing it.
example_en: That work was carried out according to the prescribed rules.

definition: the duties and obligations of a citizen of a nation.

definition: an inner portion of a house; inner apartments.

definition: the plant Cocculus hirrutu (=C. villosus) of Menispermaceae family.

definition: a white powder, sodium bicarbonate, NaHCO3, used as a leavening agent; sodium bicorbonate; baking soda.

example_en: That ascetic had been without food for many days.

definition: the condition of being excited by joy.

definition: the quality of being worthy of esteem or honour; respectability; dignity; worthiness.

definition: the nest of a sparrow.
example_en: There was a sparrow's nest on the roof.

definition: that which causes abhorrence, detestation.

example_en: He strongly expressed his dissent on that matter.

definition: excessive grief.

definition: an ambiguous speech or statement.

example_en: The officials recorded the village's census of houses and livestock.

definition: the act of jumping, leaping.

definition: curly hair.
example_en: Her curly hair fluttered in the wind.

definition: the state of being associated; companionship; fellowship; partnership; association.
example: ನಾನು ಮತ್ತು ನನ್ನ ಜೊತೆ ಬಹಳ ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಇದ್ದೇವೆ.

definition: a vertical fold of cloth (as of a sari, dhōti, etc.).

definition: the lower front part of the human body between the chest and thighs; the abdomen; the belly.

example_en: The plan received acceptance from the committee.

example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತೋಷ ಮತ್ತು ದುಃಖ ಸಯಿತವಾಗಿತ್ತು.

definition: that is made or has become red; reddened.

definition: to cause to hold a parasol (as a token of regalia).

example_en: The locomotive stopped at the station.

definition: a woman who is calm, patient and enduring.
example: ಆ ಶಾಂತೆ ಎಂತಹ ಕಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲೂ ತಾಳ್ಮೆ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That calm, patient and enduring woman never lost her patience even in hardship.

definition: to agree to; to accept; to consent.
example_en: The assembly agreed to and accepted that resolution.

definition: the quality or condition of being jealous; jealousy; envy.
example: ಗೆಳತಿಯ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಕಂಡು ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಮಚ್ಚರ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: Seeing her friend's success, jealousy arose in her.

definition: the superintendent of a kitchen (in a palace).
example: ಅರಮನೆಯ ಬಾಣಸಿವೆರ್ಗಡೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಔತಣವನ್ನೂ ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: The kitchen superintendent of the palace supervised every feast.

definition: to receive, accept oblations.
example_en: The Fire-God received the devotees' oblations.

definition: to reproach in scornful or sarcastic language; to taunt.
example: ಅವನ ಸೋಲನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರು ಅವನನ್ನು ಹಂಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Seeing his defeat, his friends taunted him.

definition: the portion of movable skin, which closes the eye-ball; eye-lid.
example_en: After the surgery, his eyelid (akṣipakṣa) swelled up.

definition: a kind of fish-catching net.
example_en: The fishermen threw the fish-catching net into the river.

definition: a highly skilled, expert workman; an adept.
example_en: He is a great expert in this work.

definition: a small or little distance.
example_en: The school was only a small distance from the house.

definition: to turn white or grey.
example_en: The cloth turned white in the sun.

definition: an act or instance of cheating or being cheated.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ನನಗೆ ದಗೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಣ ಕಸಿದುಕೊಂಡ.
example_en: That trader cheated me and took away my money.

definition: one or the same place.
example_en: Everyone stood in one and the same place and had their picture taken.

definition: (a dog, wolf, etc.) to utter the characteristic long, loud, wailing cry; to howl.
example_en: The wolves howled in the forest.

definition: an electric discharge with lightning and thunder; a thunder-bolt.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಘವಹ್ನಿ ಸಿಡಿದು ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That night a thunderbolt crashed in the sky and startled everyone.

definition: a long-handled brush of straws, twigs, bristles,etc. for sweeping; a broom.
example_en: She held the broom and swept the porch.

definition: a demanding and getting back the amount lent or forcing to pay any amount due as tax, etc..
example_en: The government began collection of the due tax.

definition: law - a) all the rules of conduct established and enforced by the authority, legislation or custom of a given community, state or other group b) any one of such rules.
example_en: The law of the country applies to everyone.

definition: a flat, broad and fairly thick piece of stone, used to sit on.
example_en: A flat stone slab was placed in the temple courtyard, for sitting on.

definition: a hollow or hollowed-out place; cavity; a hole.
example_en: A deep hollow appeared amid the rock.

definition: seven times hundred; seven hundred.
example_en: Seven hundred people had gathered for that function.

definition: in person; personally.
example_en: The officer came in person and inspected it.

definition: fallen down.
example: ಮರದಿಂದ ಪತಿತ ಎಲೆಗಳು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The leaves fallen from the tree lay on the ground.

definition: a hollow place in the stem or a branch of a tree.
example: ಆ ಒಣಗಿದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಡೋಱು ಕಂಡುಬಂತು.
example_en: A hollow was found in that dried-up branch.

definition: to hide oneself.
example_en: The cat hid itself under the bed.

definition: a school for vocational training.
example_en: A new vocational training school was opened for the village youth.

definition: having close contact, relation or dealing intimately.
example_en: The two of them had a very close and intimate relationship.

definition: a flower which is useless in causing pollination.
example_en: That useless flower is of no use for pollination.

definition: a partial or total loss of the sense of pain, temperature, touch, etc., produced by disease.
example: ಗಾಯದ ಸುತ್ತ ಅವೇದನೆ ಉಂಟಾಗಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ನೋವು ತಿಳಿಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Anaesthesia occurred around the wound and he did not feel the pain.

definition: absolutely countless.
example_en: There are absolutely countless stars in the sky.

definition: having one and the same origin.
example_en: These two words have the same origin.

definition: a lock of hair tangled, matted.
example_en: Her hair became tangled in the wind.

definition: a kind of drum or tambour.
example_en: At the festival they played the tambour and delighted the people.

definition: a binding that subjects a person to be a slave; the fetters of slavery.
example_en: They bound her with the fetters of slavery and made her a slave.

definition: any disease that is resulting in death; a fatal disease.
example_en: He contracted a fatal disease.

definition: a person having name; a nameless person.
example_en: That nameless person was not known to anyone in the town.

definition: an announcement made loudly.
example_en: The government made a loud announcement of the new scheme.

definition: a newly married woman or a woman about to be married; a bride.
example_en: The bride stood shyly in her new saree.

definition: employment, esp. public employment; service.
example_en: He obtained government employment.

definition: a large, rectangular piece of cotton, linen, silk, etc., used on a bed or as a wrapper over the body; a sheet; bedspread.
example_en: The child slept warmly, covered with a bedspread.

definition: to convey an information, idea etc. through spoken words; to tell.
example: ಕವಿ ತನ್ನ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜನ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಪೇಳ್ದನು.
example_en: The poet told the king's story in his poem.

definition: an agreement between two or more people to do something; a contract.
example_en: Both of them signed the contract.

definition: an elaborate religious sacrifice, performed to propitiate a god.
example: ರಾಜನು ದೇವರ ಪ್ರೀತಿಗಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ಸತ್ರ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: The king performed a religious sacrifice to please the god.

definition: a room on the fort for watching or storing ammunition.
example_en: The soldiers were watching for enemies from the fort room.

definition: a variety of large mosquitoes.
example_en: As evening fell, the large mosquitoes increased in the forest.

definition: an act of jumping or flying over.
example_en: The player's jump was very high.

definition: the feeling of non-attachment, interestlessness or indifference.
example_en: A feeling of indifference was clearly visible in his words.

definition: the quality, state or fact of being indifferent; lack of concern, interest or feeling; apathy; indifference.
example: ಅವನ ಉಡಾಪೆ ಧೋರಣೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಬೇಸರ ತರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His indifferent attitude annoyed everyone.

definition: anything that is doubled; two folds.
example_en: He folded the cloth into two folds and kept it.

definition: the fact of being defeated.
example_en: He suffered defeat in the game.

definition: time - a) the system of those sequential relations that any event has to any other, as past, present or future; indefinite and continuous duration regarded as that in which events succeed one another; b) the period between two events or during which something exists, happens or acts; measured or measurable interval; c) any period in the history of man or of the universe, often esp. with reference to a characteristic social structure, set of customs, famous person living then, etc. d) a definite point of time, as indicated by a clock; e) an indefinite period extending into the future; f) a particular period in a day, year; g) an appointed, favourable, proper or convenient time; h) (musc.) relative rapidity of movement; the rate of speed at which a composition or passage is played; tempo.
example: ಕಾಳ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಹಿರಿಯರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The elders say that time changes everyone.

definition: a dwelling place; a house.
example_en: This dwelling is built in the old style.

definition: the soft, lustrous fibre obtained as a filament from the cocoon of the silkworm.
example_en: That sari was woven from pure silk.

definition: a female dancer.
example_en: The female dancer stepped in tune with the music.

definition: a keeping something secret.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮುಚ್ಚುಮಱೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He kept his wealth a secret.

definition: a taste or flavour.
example_en: Everyone liked the taste of this fruit.

definition: the code of conduct to be observed by a husband and his wife in their matrimonial life.
example_en: Observing the code of matrimonial conduct is the duty of every couple.

definition: physical suffering.
example_en: He suffered physical pain because of the accident.

definition: a declaration that something will or will not be done, given, etc., by one; a promise.
example_en: He gave a promise to repay the debt.

definition: name of a folk goddess.
example_en: Worship of the folk goddess Baṭari takes place every Tuesday.

definition: to become folded or wrinkled.
example_en: The leaf dried in the sun and became wrinkled.

definition: the waste product of the body secreted by the kidneys; urine.
example_en: The doctor examined the patient's urine.

definition: a body so suspended from a fixed point as to move to and fro by the action of gravity and acquired momentum, as the one used in clocks for regulating the movement; a pendulum.
example_en: The wall clock's pendulum swung slowly to and fro.

definition: a blow by treachery (as stabbing in the back, striking a person while asleep, etc.).
example: ಶತ್ರು ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಳ್ಳೇಱು ಹೊಡೆದು ಪಲಾಯನ ಮಾಡಿದ.
example_en: The enemy struck a treacherous blow on his back and fled.

definition: the branch of medicine dealing with the prevention and treatment of diseases and injuries in animals; veterinary medicine.
example_en: He obtained a degree in veterinary medicine.

definition: accusation; contemptible remark; blame; rebuke.
example_en: I felt hurt hearing his contemptible remark.

definition: (said of wood) cut or trimmed away; peeled; planed; smoothened.
example_en: The carpenter made a chair from the smoothened wood.

definition: of Hebrew or the Hebrew.
example_en: That scripture is written in the Hebrew language.

definition: not become weak; not fallen down; not in ruins; retaining the original strength; strong.
example_en: The old fort still stands strong and undiminished today.

definition: a living; life.
example: ಈ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ವಾೞ್ತೆ ಬಡತನದಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His life in this village was full of poverty.

definition: a sweet, delicious (variety of) mango fruit.
example_en: Grandmother brought a sweet mango from the garden and gave it.

definition: a man who is being, dwelling or living with another.
example: ಅವನ ಸಹವಾಸಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಅವನ ಜೊತೆ ಊಟ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: His companion eats with him every day.

definition: the tree Calosanthes indica.
example_en: The flowers of the Kaṭvaṅga tree bloom in the evening.

definition: to be impatiently desirous (of); to have an irrepressible desire.
example_en: The child was impatiently desirous of the toy.

definition: the egg of a louse; a nit.
example_en: She noticed that there were nits in the hair.

definition: a bag holding or for carrying explosives required for firing missiles.
example_en: The soldier carried the bag of explosives on his shoulder.

definition: a sticky, colloidal carbohydrate exuded by trees such as acacia; gum.
example_en: Gum was exuding from the acacia tree.

definition: lack of brightness, lustre; dullness.
example_en: The colours of the old painting have become dull.

definition: to tie, fasten or intertwine in or with a knot or knots; make a knot or knots in.
example_en: He tied a knot in the rope and fastened the boat.

definition: a male bison; a wild buffalo.
example_en: The wild bison appeared deep in the forest.

definition: the act or an instance of conveying (something from one place to another).
example_en: The conveying of the goods happened early in the morning.

definition: the large vulture Gyps bengalensis of Acciptridae family, with bald-head, naked neck, white back and shoulder, large wings, short but strong curved beak, black legs, that feeds on dead animals; Indian white-backed vulure.
example: ರಕ್ಕಸವಕ್ಕಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ರೆಕ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಚ್ಚಿ ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The large vulture was circling in the sky with its large wings spread.

definition: to have trust, confidence or rely on; to have faith.
example_en: The child had relied entirely on its mother.

definition: to put down; to reduce in height, elevation, amount, price etc.
example_en: The contractor reduced the height of the building.

definition: the jet black colour.
example_en: Her hair shone with a jet black colour.

definition: to feed - a) to give food to; to provide food for; b) to provide or serve as food.
example_en: They provide food to the poor.

definition: the condition of being bound.
example_en: He felt pain seeing the tightness of the rope binding.

definition: to move with some force (said of the wind or a current of air); to blow.
example_en: The wind was blowing forcefully on the hill.

definition: an installation of an idol in the prescribed religious manner.
example_en: Everyone gathered for the installation of the village deity.

definition: the state or quality of being hard (as a metal).
example_en: The hardness of that metal made it difficult to cut.

definition: a room or building for storing threshed grain; a granary.
example_en: The farmers stored the harvested grain in the granary.

definition: the work of a carpenter; carpentry.
example_en: He had learned carpentry since childhood.

definition: sometimes; occasionally; not always.
example_en: Sometimes he meets me.

definition: a framework consisting of two parallel bamboo sidepieces connected by a series of rungs or crosspieces on which a person steps in climbing up or down; a ladder.
example_en: He climbed to the terrace using the ladder.

definition: the place of one's living.
example_en: His dwelling was on the riverbank.

definition: amounting to sixteen.
example_en: Sixteen players participated in that game.

definition: the speed of an arrow shot with greeat force.
example_en: The arrow reached the target with the speed of a shot arrow.

definition: to be or become deficient, insufficient; to become inadequate in amount or numbers.
example_en: During the rainy season, the water supply became deficient.

definition: a seller of betel leaves.
example_en: The betel leaf seller was selling betel leaves on the street.

definition: the act of praising, extolling or flattering.
example_en: People engaged in praising him.

definition: that which is dim or lacks lustre.
example_en: The light faded and the whole room appeared dim.

definition: never changing or varying; unchangeable; immutable.
example_en: Some mathematical constants are immutable values.

definition: the quality of being a rake, libertine; libertinism; licentiousness.
example: ಆ ಯುವಕನ ಸಿತಗತನ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The whole village knew about that young man's licentiousness.

definition: violent or impetuous; sudden and forceful.
example_en: A flood occurred in the town due to the violent, sudden rain.

definition: a devastating arrow or missile.
example_en: A devastating arrow was launched at the enemy army.

definition: the state being free from serfdom, slavery, subjection to some force, compulsion, etc.; independence.
example_en: The slave finally attained his freedom.

definition: born from the sea.
example: ಅರ್ಣವಜಾತ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲ್ಪಡುವ ಈ ರತ್ನ ಸಮುದ್ರದಿಂದ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This gem, said to be born from the sea, came from the ocean.

definition: Kaḷi, as the goddess of war.
example_en: In the battle they worshipped the goddess of war with devotion.

definition: the act, quality, tendency or an instance of forbearing, toleratingor enduring; toleration; forbearance; endurance.
example_en: Because of his forbearance, the quarrel was avoided.

definition: the occupation of making, repairing and selling of jewelry.
example_en: He lives by doing the jewelry-making and selling business in the town.

definition: the quality of being not eager or willing to work or exert oneself.
example_en: Everyone knew about his laziness.

definition: sounds expressing joy, as by children.
example_en: The house was filled with the children's joyful laughter.

definition: to untie the belt or string tied round the neck of a dog.
example_en: The hunter untied the rope around the dog's neck.

definition: to put forth branches.
example_en: In the rainy season the tree put forth branches.

definition: the direction opposite to north; south.
example_en: His house is in the southern part of the village.

definition: (twilight) to set in.
example_en: Twilight set in behind the hill.

definition: a poet who sings ballads and songs, esp. on the past heros.
example_en: The ballad-singer's songs are famous in folklore.

definition: a conducting or managing of a business or directing the affairs of a company, firm, etc.
example: ಆ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ವಹಿವಾಟಿ ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: That company's business is growing day by day.

definition: a single mast (of a shape).
example_en: That boat had only a single mast.
